translationRepairs: The Bohai people of Raozhou rose at a subordinate city under Goutou, fielding more than thirty thousand infantry and cavalry; no summons could make them submit.
The Bohai people of Raozhou joined forces with a touxia appanage city in rebellion, fielding more than thirty thousand infantry and cavalry; summonses failed to bring them to submit.

頭下城 is a Liao touxia appanage city, not a person named Goutou, and 結構 means to conspire or join forces. The revision restores the institution and natural syntax without turning the city type into a plural organizer.
He later retired as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and died in office.
He later retired as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and died.
後以太子太傅致仕，卒 records retirement from office (致仕) followed by death (卒); "died in office" contradicts 致仕. The proposed English correctly separates retirement and death.
For his merit he was made chancellor of the Northern Prefecture, with the additional title of left vice director and concurrent commander of the Eastern Route army.
For his merit he was made chancellor of the Northern Prefecture, with the additional title of left vice director and concurrent commander of the Northeast Route army.
兼東北路都統 names the Northeast Route (東北路), not an Eastern Route; the idiomatic English dropped 北. The proposed replacement restores the full route name.
